verdict.rationale: Supabase's Realtime docs list Presence ("Track and synchronize user state across clients... who's online") and Broadcast ("Send low-latency messages between clients... cursor tracking, game events") as first-party features, with typing-indicator and online-presence use cases. A community launch thread has the CEO describing Broadcast as ephemeral messages and Presence as eventually-consistent state, built on Elixir/Phoenix. missing for 10: no in-depth API or limits documentation in the evidence, and no independent hands-on corroboration of presence and broadcast behavior.
